en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey industrial and residential building complex in a semi‑rural setting, backed by wooded hills. The right wing bears a large sign in German indicating a factory. A dirt road curves in front of the building, with fields and simple fencing in the foreground. Additional buildings and a small towered structure appear in the background. Printed location text is at the upper left, and the photographer's credit appears at the bottom left.
